cohort: 220 women diagnosed with Peripartum Cardiomyopathy (PPCM) from the University of Pennsylvania Health System.
finding: African American women with PPCM were diagnosed younger, later postpartum, presented with more severe disease (lower LVEF), were more likely to worsen, failed to recover more often, and took longer to recover compared to non-African American women.
followup_time: At least 265 days (median time to recovery)
